title: Application-agnostic screen/event function-reference matrix
intent: Model application UI transitions as a rectangular 2D array of callable functions; row is current rendered screen or its alias, column is event; pass one context object holding all mutable variables into the selected function.

boundaries.relationship: Inner application controller; outer Programs dispatch/runtime contract remains PROG-SRS-001.

matrix.representation: row-major rectangular array of callable function references or unsupported marker

topology.function_reference_policy: authorized callable loaded from code; never eval untrusted strings; persisted symbolic IDs are resolved during initialization
topology.definition_lifecycle: validated, versioned and immutable while loaded

namespaces.application: domain variables owned by an application

context_contract.mutation_convention: one explicit versioned choice: isolated in-place working context or returned revised context
context_contract.revision_control: monotonic revision or equivalent optimistic compare-and-set
context_contract.rendered_screen_semantics: last confirmed rendered/published screen, not merely a requested next screen

processing.require: authenticated normalized event, correctly associated instance and context revision
validate cell callable or explicitly unsupported
call exactly selected handler with one context object
validate state, next screen, effects and result classification
authorized effects and rendering with receipt/correlation
update renderedScreen only after acknowledged render/publication criterion
commit checked context revision; distinguish success, partial outcome and failure

invariants.rule: matrix dimensions exactly equal declared screen/event axes
every cell callable or explicit unsupported, no ragged rows
alias resolves uniquely to canonical screen without extra row
row from renderedScreen; column from event.id
exactly one handler, one context argument
all mutable application state in context
context contains current screen, event, identity, version and revision
unsupported cell rejects without fallback unless explicitly defined
application decisions belong in application handlers, not dispatcher
per-instance event concurrency policy is explicit
new apps register definitions without modifying generic dispatcher

failure_taxonomy.reporting_rule: always report handler-invoked flag, possible external side effect and last-confirmed renderedScreen

verification.minimum_acceptance: Executable table-driven tests and verified receipts; document creation alone is not conformance.

open_decisions: non-JSON context values and service references
prohibited_assumptions: application completion semantics in generic dispatcher
interpreting symbolic handler text as code
